ev.q: This finding is the first known detection of F. tularensis in a marine mammal.
No ill persons or additional cases were identified.
six specimens tested positive by PCR, and three were forwarded to CDC's Division of Vector-Borne Diseases
No ill persons or additional cases were identified.
The clinical isolate from the human case was destroyed in accordance with the Tier 1 select agent handling protocol
tularemia occurred in a wildlife volunteer after exposure to a deceased, infected harbor seal
Public health authorities identified one other wildlife volunteer present during the necropsy.

methods_quotes.q: Molecular sequencing (six housekeeping genes; 4,107 base pairs) of the lung specimen performed by CDC
